results.title: The Fly: The Abyss of Mutation
results.overview: A journalist probes a corporate pollution scandal and uncovers a secret island lab where her father runs a classified fly DNA experiment, only to find it overrun by giant mutant killer flies.

results.title: TSCHERNOBYL 86
results.overview: Forty years since Chernobyl. Volker Heise’s new film recounts the 1986 nuclear disaster for the first time from the perspectives of both East and West Germany and Ukraine, using archive footage only. TSCHERNOBYL 86 is a gripping political thriller featuring previously unseen archive material which brings the events of that time into an unsettlingly present-day context.​

results.title: OUTspoken: The Porn Academy
results.overview: Pull back the curtain on straight-identifying men as they cross social taboos and step into the world of gay adult content, turning curiosity and controversy into a business.

results.title: The Day We Embraced the Universe
results.original_title: あの日、宇宙を抱きしめた。
results.overview: A series of mysterious abductions by colorful aliens has been spreading fear across the globe. Amid the chaos, Aoi continues to live a peaceful life with her boyfriend, Yuzu. But one night, while Aoi is asleep, Yuzu is abducted by the colorful aliens. As anti-alien sentiment intensifies across Earth, Aoi begins rigorous training, driven by her desire for revenge. Then one day, deep in the forest, she encounters a different kind of alien...

results.title: Me, Myself and Vegas
results.overview: A young woman from England struggling to find a partner to walk her down the aisle goes to Las Vegas where she marries herself in this documentary of self love.

results.title: A Darker Place: Cases from the DCA
results.original_title: A Darker Place: Cases from the DCA
results.overview: A team of D.C.A. Bio-Enforcers falls prey to a rogue anomaly, trapped in a nightmarish dimension where reality bends to the creature's will.

results.title: The Beach Player
results.overview: Former D1 volleyball star TJ O'Michael, now a washed-up beach coach, schemes to profit off a wealthy couple's collapsing marriage, with his estranged father by his side.

results.title: Connected
results.overview: After her parents divorce Cat and her mother Margaret move into their family's farmhouse, Cat befriends Elise who lives in another time period. Their friendship gives Cat the very thing she lost. Connection.

results.title: Ghosts: Inside The Movie
results.overview: The Making of Ghosts The Possession of Button House

results.title: It Takes a Year
results.overview: Klara and her family are mourning the death of their mother when  flowers appear on their doorstep from “Margrete”. But who is Margrete, and why won’t the family tell Klara who it is?

results.title: The Seeing Eye Dog Who Saw Too Much
results.original_title: The Seeing Eye Dog Who Saw Too Much
results.overview: In 1975, Italian director Enrico Januzzi began filming a giallo set in Rome - a feverish tale of a blind violinist who rises to first chair of the symphony, only to find herself stalked as a black-gloved killer murders her fellow musicians one by one. The only witness: her seeing-eye dog. Production collapsed after a week, and the footage was presumed lost, until its rediscovery in 2025. Painstakingly restored by WBAZ Films, this surviving fragment is presented here for the very first time.

results.title: Мастер
results.overview: The documentary "Master" is dedicated to one of the most prominent figures in the history of Russian cinema—the brilliant film scholar, Chairman of the Russian State Cinematography Committee, professor at VGIK, and longtime president of the Window to Europe film festival—Armen Nikolaevich Medvedev. The film's central focus is the 1990s, a turning point for the country and a pivotal moment in Medvedev's career. Separate chapters are devoted to VGIK and the Vyborg Film Festival, the film's subject's beloved creative outlets. The film draws on the recollections of colleagues, friends, and students, who speak with sincere warmth and gratitude about the master's role in their lives and the life of Russian cinema.

results.title: Around the Clock
results.overview: As a single mother, Irena has to divide her time between caring for her family and working a full-time job, however, luckily, her coworkers and other women in her life that share her struggles try their best to help her out in this monotonous routine.

results.title: Rosso Volante
results.overview: The four decisive years in the life of Eugenio Monti, from the bronze medals in the bobsleigh at Innsbruck 1964 to the Grenoble Olympics in 1968. Amidst grueling training sessions, falls, and comebacks, this is the portrait of a champion who challenged his limits with talent, loyalty, and courage, supported by love and friendship. Inspired by the literary work of Stefano Rotta.

results.title: Star Cash
results.overview: Following a personal search for meaning through astrology, filmmaker Hayley Garrigus discovers an unexpected intersection between astrology and financial markets.  As she explores this world of financial astrology, where traders use planetary movements to predict market trends, a deeper truth emerges. Through interviews with astrologers, financial analysts, and those bridging both worlds, the film reveals how our obsession with controlling the future disconnects us from ancient wisdom about cycles and our place in the cosmos. In seeking certainty, have we lost something more profound about what it means to be part of the universe?

results.title: Meteor Extinction
results.overview: A planet-destroying meteor is heading straight for Earth. Nothing we haven’t seen before. NASA uses a laser to destroy it. The day is saved… until it’s revealed that the comet was made entirely of an element that when heated up (in this case by laser) turns into molten magma in the sky, and there is enough of it to cover the entire planet in this hyper-heated coating and destroy the world. Liquid being impervious to the usual ways of stopping meteors, NASA and Space Force must put their heads together to solve hell from raining down upon them.

results.title: Smokers
results.overview: Smokers (Los Fumadores) is a drama about two Cuban exiles living in Miami, Rita and Gustavo, and their day-to-day lives. After tragedy occurs, Rita's estranged son Manuel arrives to spend time with her. He soon becomes obsessed over a family secret regarding his deceased sister. He attempts to come to terms with this secret while reconciling with his mother.

results.title: WAVE PHASE3 Reboot 7th ~ NAMI 1
results.overview: WAVE PHASE3 Reboot 7th ~ NAMI 1 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling WAVE It took place on April 1 2026 at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Toh, Ti Ani Fuji
results.overview: In a world where love is filtered, scored and predicted, a couple in Pune, India, collides in a fierce, consuming romance. What begins in urgency and desire slowly fractures. Time intrudes. Ambition shifts. Affection turns conditional. What once felt infinite begins to bruise and break. Seven years later, beneath the shadow of Mount Fuji, they meet again. Japan is quieter. The air is thinner.  They are no longer who they were. Carrying different lives, different scars, they stand face to face with a past that never truly left them.  Can love survive its own history or does it merely haunt those who try to return to it? Toh, Ti Ani Fuji is an intimate, visually driven meditation on love, memory and the fragile, devastating hope of second chances.

results.title: Hening Rindu
results.overview: The story of Mariam, who is married to a drug addict, Hakim. Mariam's suffering and sacrifice in continuing her life with her children are severely tested when she is arrested and imprisoned for a crime she did not commit. Her suffering is compounded when her stepmother conspires with Hakim to sell her infant child to a wealthy couple. The climax comes after her stepmother passes away when she discovers that her late stepmother had sold the ancestral land and house left behind by her father.
